label: Team
why: Founder/leadership track record, key-person risk, completeness of bench.

label: Market
why: TAM, segment growth, regulatory exposure, AI commoditization risk.

label: Product Velocity
why: Release cadence, feature shipping rate, evidence of product depth.

label: Demand & Growth
why: Triangulated traffic + downloads + branded search + reviews.

label: CAC Efficiency
why: Channel mix, organic share, branded search ratio, paid burn ratio.

label: Retention
why: NRR/GRR, cohort retention, app rating durability, review-velocity health.

label: Unit Economics
why: Gross margin, LTV/CAC, payback, inference cost compression.

label: Hiring Signal
why: QoQ headcount delta, senior hires, open roles, departures.

label: Capital
why: Runway, time since last round, lead-investor activity, dilution trajectory.

label: Governance
why: Board composition, founder commitment, legal exposure, info rights.
